classAbility.name: Overpower
classAbility.effect: When the Warrior makes an Attack or Charge roll, reduce the target's Tough by 1 for each Surge generated by that roll, to a minimum of Tough 0. This applies only to that Attack or Charge Impact.

subclasses.name: Berserker
subclasses.description: Berserkers sacrifice their own safety for bursts of speed and overwhelming aggression.

signatureAbility.name: Frenzy
effect: Suffer 2 Damage that cannot be saved or prevented.
Until the end of the Round:
Add X Attacks to your next attack.
Where X is half your Body characteristic, rounded up.
The additional Attack dice are consumed when the Attack is resolved.

subclasses.assaultPhaseNote: The Berserker has no default ranged weapon. Ranged equipment may be acquired normally.

subclasses.name: Knight
subclasses.description: Knights specialize in holding positions, controlling Engagements, and resisting enemy advances.

signatureAbility.name: Hold the Line
effect: When targeted by an Attack or Charge, gain Tough X against that Attack or its Charge Impact, where X is half your Body characteristic, rounded up.
Additionally, ignore any forced movement caused by the triggering Attack or Charge.

optionalEquipment.name: Shield
optionalEquipment.effect: Improves Armor by one step when the equipment restrictions permit it.

subclasses.assaultPhaseNote: The Knight has no default ranged weapon. Ranged equipment may be acquired normally.

subclasses.name: Fighter
subclasses.description: Fighters rely on disciplined technique, versatility, and consistent weapon performance.

signatureAbility.name: Finesse
signatureAbility.effect: Once per Round, when making one Weapon Attack, gain Accurate X, where X is your Agility characteristic. If the rerolled dice Surges, the attack gains Critical 1.

notes: The Fighter does not begin with a default ranged weapon, but its Finesse ability may be used with eligible ranged Weapon Attacks.
